description: Search the USGS The National Map product catalog within a bounding box for downloadable geospatial data — topographic maps, elevation/lidar, hydrography, imagery, boundaries, and structures. Optional keyword, dataset name, and file format filters. Returns title, format, file size, publication date, and direct download URL for each match. Data: tnmaccess.nationalmap.gov (USGS National Geospatial Program), no auth required.

datasets.description: Dataset name to filter by, from usgs-nationalmap.list_datasets (e.g. "US Topo", "National Elevation Dataset (NED) 1/3 arc-second").

keyword.description: Free-text keyword to filter products by title/description (e.g. "elevation", "lidar").

max.description: Maximum number of products to return, 1-50 (default 10).

max_lat.description: Maximum (northern) latitude of the bounding box, in decimal degrees (e.g. 40.0).

max_lon.description: Maximum (eastern) longitude of the bounding box, in decimal degrees (e.g. -104.0).

min_lat.description: Minimum (southern) latitude of the bounding box, in decimal degrees (e.g. 39.0).

min_lon.description: Minimum (western) longitude of the bounding box, in decimal degrees (e.g. -105.0).

name: usgs-nationalmap.products.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search USGS National Map Products
